metadata.name: openpump_mayhem
metadata.description: OpenPump Mayhem: protocol market-making vault that buys, sells and burns mayhem-mode coins through the curve

instructions.name: burn_tokens
docs: After the deadline anyone can burn what the vault still holds of the coin.

instructions.name: buy
docs: Trader buys `sol_amount` of the coin from the vault, only if the curve's spot price is within
`tolerance_bps` of `reference` (lamports/token × 1e9) and the amount is under the sweep cap.

instructions.name: init_state
docs: Register a mayhem-mode coin (its curve must carry `is_mayhem_mode`). Called right after launch.

instructions.name: sell
docs: Trader sells `token_amount` from the vault within the price tolerance. `retained_reserve_bps`
caps the SOL taken out at that share of the curve's real reserves (never drains a curve).

instructions.name: sweep_fees
docs: Realised profit (vault SOL above what is still deployed + rent) goes to the fee recipient.

instructions.name: withdraw_admin
docs: Admin takes SOL out of the vault.

instructions.name: withdraw_quote_admin
docs: Admin takes a token out of the vault (e.g. unsold coin after a campaign).

errors.name: PriceOutOfRange
errors.msg: Spot price outside the reference tolerance

errors.name: RetainedReserve
errors.msg: Sell would take more than the retained reserve allows

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: Pubkey::default() = native SOL curve; otherwise the SPL/Token-2022 quote mint (v2 family).

fields.name: is_holder_reward
docs: If set, `creator` is the ["holder-rewards", mint] PDA and the creator fee is paid out to holders.

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Per-coin creator fee override (bps). 0 = follow the fee schedule.

fields.name: is_mayhem_mode
docs: Launched in mayhem mode: the mayhem vault trades it until its deadline, then burns.

fields.name: sol_deployed
docs: Net SOL currently deployed across all mayhem coins (lamports, signed so sells can overshoot).
